;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] kills 60 people in an [[arson]] attack in the [[Town|town]] [[Rann, Borno|Rann]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-insurgency/boko-haram-killed-at-least-60-in-mondays-attack-in-nigeria-amnesty-idUSKCN1PQ55I (Reuters)]
*Seven people were killed and 26 injured in a [[Bicycle bomb|bike bombing]] at a market in [[Mokha]], [[Yemen]]. [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] were blamed for the attack. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/bomb-blast-kills-7-yemeni-civilians-in-market (''The Straits Times'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tornadoes of 2019]]
**A tornado in eastern [[Havana]], [[Cuba]], kills three people and injures 174 others. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/01/28/tornado-hits-havana-cuban-president-says-3-dead-174-hurt-n963396 (Euronews)]

;International relations 
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] tells Conservative lawmakers that she plans to hold a vote in parliament on her [[Brexit]] deal on February 13. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/01/28/world/europe/28reuters-britain-eu-may-vote.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*Six [[Tanzania]]n children are  killed for their eyes, ears and other body parts. A [[Njombe Region|Njombe district]] official, who found many were taken when they were home alone whilst their parents were working, believes that [[Tanzania#human rights|superstitious beliefs]] and witchcraft are involved. Four other missing children have been found alive. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47030924 (BBC News)]
*The [[United States Department of Justice|United States Justice Department]], [[Department of Homeland Security]], [[Department of Commerce]] and [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] announces 23 criminal charges against [[PRC|China]]'s telecom [[Huawei]] and its chief financial officer [[Wanzhou Meng]], which include [[Financial crime#Fraud|banking and financial fraud]], [[money laundering]], [[Mail and wire fraud|wire fraud]], [[Conspiracy against the United States|conspiracy to defraud the United States]], [[Chinese espionage in the United States|theft of trade secret technology]], provided bonus to workers who [[Chinese intelligence activity abroad|stole confidential information from companies around the world]], [[obstruction of justice]] and [[Sanctions against Iran|sanctions violations]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47036515 (BBC News)]
*[[Pecan Park raid]]
**[[Texas State Police|Texas Police]] shoot and kill two homeowners after invading their house. 5 officers were injured in a substantial [[Shootout|shootout]] in [[Harris County, Texas|Harris County]] near [[Houston]]. Reports later indicated one of the officers lied that drugs were in the house. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/houston-police-embroiled-scandal-lies-found-knock-warrant/story?id=60991293 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[Crisis in Venezuela]], [[Cold War II|Second Cold War]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury]] imposes sanctions on Venezuela's state-owned oil company [[PDVSA]], which accounts for much of [[Economy_of_Venezuela#Trade|Venezuela’s income]] and foreign currency. [https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sm594 (United States Department of the Treasury)]
**[[Kremlin Press Secretary]] [[Dmitry Peskov]] denies the presence of Russian mercenaries in Venezuela, despite earlier reports that up to 100 may have been deployed to protect President [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/2183898/russia-denies-sending-mercenaries-protect-venezuela-president (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[2019 State of the Union Address]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] accepts House Speaker [[Nancy Pelosi]]'s invitation to deliver the [[State of the Union]] Address on February 5. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/pelosi-invites-trump-to-deliver-state-of-the-union-on-feb-5/2019/01/28/9076e7a0-2344-11e9-90cd-dedb0c92dc17_story.html?utm_term=.e4275559a80a (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**[[Semilla (Guatemala)|Semilla Movement]] announces that on March 3 it will officially proclaim the presidential candidacy of former [[Attorney General of Guatemala|Attorney General]] [[Thelma Aldana]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/former-chief-prosecutor-to-run-for-president-in-guatemala/4764132.html  (Voice of America)]
*The 2018 [[Corruption Perceptions Index]] names [[Somalia]] as the most corrupt country in the world, followed by  [[South Sudan]] and [[Syria]], while [[Denmark]] was again named the least corrupt country. The [[United States]] drops out of the top 20 least corrupt countries for the first time since 2011. [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-6643529/Somalia-named-worlds-corrupt-country-Denmark-one-watch.html (''Daily Mail'')]
